answer: Each agent identity is registered in mesa, a consensus contract that accepts only zero-knowledge attestations from TPM/SGX enclaves and anchors measurement hashes in voyage. quill is the verification circuit, checking enclave freshness and hardware clock-drift bounds before granting tasks. Forging N identities requires compromising or physically provisioning N distinct devices; a quadratic bonding curve charges O(N^2), while failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
